title: taskctl generic webhook event
description: JSON body posted by WebhookDispatcher to non-Discord, non-Slack URLs. Discord embeds and Slack blocks are transport adapters and are not part of this contract.

event.description: Lifecycle event name, such as audit or task_completed.

task_id.description: Task id without brackets, such as 01.2.

details.description: Caller-supplied metadata. High-cardinality values stay inside this object.
